## Method Framework

::: {.horiz}
::: {.hl-purple}
**1. Experiment**

1 subject, 10 overground walking strides

Mocap + force plates
:::

::: {.hl-blue}
**2. Inverse analysis**

OpenSim IK + MocoInverse

$\rightarrow$ estimated activations of 40 muscles
:::

::: {.hl-electric}
**3. Synergy extraction**

NMF: $M \approx WH$

Keep $H \in \mathbb{R}^{10 \times 40}$
:::

::: {.hl-canopy}
**4. Predictive RL**

SAC policy outputs synergy weights

Hyfydy, H2190 model
:::
:::

::: {.fragment}
- Human data is used **only** to build the action space, never as a tracking target
- Baseline: the same pipeline with an **independent** controller that sets every
  muscle excitation directly
- Evaluated against **two external** treadmill datasets (22 + 8 subjects)
  [@camargo2021dataset; @scherpereel2023dataset]
:::
